title: Release and Version History Manager
objective: Prepare repeatable releases using reviewed commits, tags and change summaries.

milestones.title: Scope and repository setup
acceptance_criteria: Describe the goal, base repository and boundaries.
Choose a disposable or authorized repository.

milestones.title: Implement the workflow
acceptance_criteria: Complete the required Git operations in a logical order.
Capture command output or state evidence.

milestones.title: Verify and recover
acceptance_criteria: Verify the resulting files, refs and history.
Describe at least one failure mode and recovery strategy.
Do not claim tests or remote operations that were not run.

milestones.title: Document the outcome
acceptance_criteria: Document security, collaboration and safety assumptions.
Summarize limitations and one possible improvement.

required_features: Create annotated version tags on verified commits
Compare the previous tag with the release candidate
Record release notes and required verification evidence
stretch_features: Document signature verification and its trust assumptions
test_plan: Run the workflow in a disposable repository or approved shared test repo.
Inspect git status and relevant history after each state-changing stage.
Verify any created tag/branch/backup explicitly and document actual evidence.
review_method: Human-reviewed Git workflow/project with static validation of the submitted evidence record. CodeLeaf does not execute arbitrary Git commands or modify a remote repository on the learner’s behalf.
